verses.text_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُزَّمِّلُ

trs.20: O you who wraps himself [in clothing]<sup foot_note=197635>1</sup>
trs.85: You [Prophet], enfolded in your cloak!
trs.22: O thou folded in garments!
trs.203: O you wrapped in garments (i.e. Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)!

verses.text_uthmani: قُمِ ٱلَّيْلَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا

trs.20: Arise [to pray] the night, except for a little -
trs.85: Stay up throughout the night, all but a small part of it,
trs.22: Stand (to prayer) by night, but not all night,-
trs.203: Stand (to pray) all night, except a little -

verses.text_uthmani: نِّصْفَهُۥٓ أَوِ ٱنقُصْ مِنْهُ قَلِيلًا

trs.20: Half of it - or subtract from it a little
trs.85: half, or a little less,
trs.22: Half of it,- or a little less,
trs.203: Half of it or a little less than that,

verses.text_uthmani: أَوْ زِدْ عَلَيْهِ وَرَتِّلِ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَرْتِيلًا

trs.20: Or add to it, and recite the Qur’ān with measured recitation.
trs.85: or a little more; recite the Quran slowly and distinctly:
trs.22: Or a little more; and recite the Qur'an in slow, measured rhythmic tones.
trs.203: Or a little more. And recite the Qur’ân (aloud) in a slow, (pleasant tone and) style.<sup foot_note=155014>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّا سَنُلْقِى عَلَيْكَ قَوْلًا ثَقِيلًا

trs.20: Indeed, We will cast upon you a heavy word.<sup foot_note=197636>1</sup>
trs.85: We shall send a momentous message down to you.
trs.22: Soon shall We send down to thee a weighty Message.
trs.203: Verily, We shall send down to you a weighty Word (i.e. obligations, laws).

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيْلِ هِىَ أَشَدُّ وَطْـًٔا وَأَقْوَمُ قِيلًا

trs.20: Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue]<sup foot_note=197638>1</sup> and more suitable for words.<sup foot_note=197637>2</sup>
trs.85: Night prayer makes a deeper impression and sharpens words––
trs.22: Truly the rising by night is most potent for governing (the soul), and most suitable for (framing) the Word (of Prayer and Praise).
trs.203: Verily, the rising by night (for Tahajjud prayer) is very hard and most potent and good for governing oneself, and most suitable for (understanding) the Word (of Allâh).

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبْحًا طَوِيلًا

trs.20: Indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation.
trs.85: you are kept busy for long periods of the day––
trs.22: True, there is for thee by day prolonged occupation with ordinary duties:
trs.203: Verily, there is for you by day prolonged occupation with ordinary duties.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلًا

trs.20: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion.
trs.85: so celebrate the name of your Lord and devote yourself wholeheart-edly to Him.
trs.22: But keep in remembrance the name of thy Lord and devote thyself to Him whole-heartedly.
trs.203: And remember the Name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with a complete devotion.

verses.text_uthmani: رَّبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلًا

trs.20: [He is] the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of [your] affairs.<sup foot_note=197639>1</sup>
trs.85: He is Lord of the east and west, there is no god but Him, so take Him as your Protector,
trs.22: (He is) Lord of the East and the West: there is no god but He: take Him therefore for (thy) Disposer of Affairs.
trs.203: (He Alone is) the Lord of the east and the west; Lâ ilâha illâ Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He). So take Him Alone as Wakîl (Disposer of your affairs).<sup foot_note=155015>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱهْجُرْهُمْ هَجْرًا جَمِيلًا

trs.20: And be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance.
trs.85: patiently endure what they say, ignore them politely,
trs.22: And have patience with what they say, and leave them with noble (dignity).
trs.203: And be patient (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) with what they say, and keep away from them in a good way.

verses.text_uthmani: وَذَرْنِى وَٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُو۟لِى ٱلنَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا

trs.20: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little.
trs.85: and leave to Me those who deny the truth and live in luxury. Bear with them for a little while;
trs.22: And leave Me (alone to deal with) those in possession of the good things of life, who (yet) deny the Truth; and bear with them for a little while.
trs.203: And leave Me Alone to deal with the beliers (those who deny My Verses), those who are in possession of good things of life. And give them respite for a little while.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ لَدَيْنَآ أَنكَالًا وَجَحِيمًا

trs.20: Indeed, with Us [for them] are shackles and burning fire.
trs.85: We have fetters, a blazing fire,
trs.22: With Us are Fetters (to bind them), and a Fire (to burn them),
trs.203: Verily, with Us are fetters (to bind them), and a raging Fire.

verses.text_uthmani: وَطَعَامًا ذَا غُصَّةٍ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمًا

trs.20: And food that chokes and a painful punishment -
trs.85: food that chokes, and agonizing torment in store for them
trs.22: And a Food that chokes, and a Penalty Grievous.
trs.203: And a food that chokes, and a painful torment.

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًا مَّهِيلًا

trs.20: On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down.
trs.85: on the Day when the earth and the mountains will shake. The mountains will become a heap of loose sand.
trs.22: One Day the earth and the mountains will be in violent commotion. And the mountains will be as a heap of sand poured out and flowing down.
trs.203: On the Day when the earth and the mountains will be in violent shake, and the mountains will be a heap of sand poured out.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًا شَـٰهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًا

trs.20: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.
trs.85: We have sent a messenger to you [people] to be your witness, just as We sent a messenger to Pharaoh,
trs.22: We have sent to you, (O men!) a messenger, to be a witness concerning you, even as We sent a messenger to Pharaoh.
trs.203: Verily, We have sent to you (O men) a Messenger (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) to be a witness over you, as We did send a Messenger [Mûsâ (Moses)] to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh).<sup foot_note=155016>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ أَخْذًا وَبِيلًا

trs.20: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a ruinous seizure.
trs.85: but Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger and so We inflicted a heavy punishment on him.
trs.22: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger; so We seized him with a heavy Punishment.
trs.203: But Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) disobeyed the Messenger [Mûsâ (Moses)]; so We seized him with a severe punishment.

verses.text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًا يَجْعَلُ ٱلْوِلْدَٰنَ شِيبًا

trs.20: Then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a Day that will make the children white-haired?<sup foot_note=197640>1</sup>
trs.85: So if you disbelieve, how can you guard yourselves against a Day that will turn children’s hair grey,
trs.22: Then how shall ye, if ye deny (Allah), guard yourselves against a Day that will make children hoary-headed?-
trs.203: Then how can you avoid the punishment, if you disbelieve, on a Day (i.e. the Day of Resurrection) that will make the children grey-headed?

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌۢ بِهِۦ ۚ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَفْعُولًا

trs.20: The heaven will break apart therefrom;<sup foot_note=197641>1</sup> ever is His promise fulfilled.
trs.85: a Day when the sky will be torn apart? God’s promise will certainly be fulfilled.
trs.22: Whereon the sky will be cleft asunder? His Promise needs must be accomplished.
trs.203: Whereon the heaven will be cleft asunder? His Promise is certainly to be accomplished.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا

trs.20: Indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his Lord a way.
trs.85: This is a reminder. Let whoever wishes take the way to his Lord.
trs.22: Verily this is an Admonition: therefore, whoso will, let him take a (straight) path to his Lord!
trs.203: Verily, this is an admonition: therefore whosoever will, let him take a Path to His Lord!

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَىِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةٌ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرْضَىٰ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَـٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ۚ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا ۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًا وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْرًا ۚ وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌۢ

trs.20: Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muḥammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allāh determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it<sup foot_note=197643>1</sup> and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur’ān. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allāh and others fighting for the cause of Allāh. So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakāh and loan Allāh a goodly loan.<sup foot_note=197642>2</sup> And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allāh. It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
trs.85: [Prophet], your Lord is well aware that you sometimes spend nearly two-thirds of the night at prayer––sometimes half, sometimes a third––as do some of your followers. God determines the division of night and day. He knows that you will not be able to keep a measure of it and He has relented towards all of you, so recite as much of the Quran as is easy for you. He knows that some of you will be sick, some of you travelling through the land seeking God’s bounty, some of you fighting in God’s way: recite as much as is easy for you, keep up the prayer, pay the prescribed alms, and make God a good loan. Whatever good you store up for yourselves will be improved and increased for you. Ask God for His forgiveness, He is most forgiving, most merciful.
trs.22: Thy Lord doth know that thou standest forth (to prayer) nigh two-thirds of the night, or half the night, or a third of the night, and so doth a party of those with thee. But Allah doth appoint night and day in due measure He knoweth that ye are unable to keep count thereof. So He hath turned to you (in mercy): read ye, therefore, of the Qur'an as much as may be easy for you. He knoweth that there may be (some) among you in ill-health; others travelling through the land, seeking of Allah's bounty; yet others fighting in Allah's Cause, read ye, therefore, as much of the Qur'an as may be easy (for you); and establish regular Prayer and give regular Charity; and loan to Allah a Beautiful Loan. And whatever good ye send forth for your souls ye shall find it in Allah's Presence,- yea, better and greater, in Reward and seek ye the Grace of Allah: for Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
trs.203: Verily, your Lord knows that you do stand (to pray at night) a little less than two thirds of the night, or half the night, or a third of the night, and also a party of those with you. And Allâh measures the night and the day. He knows that you are unable to pray the whole night, so He has turned to you (in mercy). So, recite you of the Qur’ân as much as may be easy for you. He knows that there will be some among you sick, others travelling through the land, seeking of Allâh’s Bounty, yet others fighting in Allâh’s Cause. So recite as much of the Qur’ân as may be easy (for you), and perform As-Salât (Iqâmat-as-Salât ) and give Zakât, and lend to Allâh a goodly loan. And whatever good you send before you for yourselves (i.e. Nawâfil non-obligatory acts of worship: prayers, charity, fasting, Hajj and ‘Umrah), you will certainly find it with Allâh, better and greater in reward. And seek Forgiveness of Allâh. Verily, Allâh is Oft-Forgiving, Most-Merciful<sup foot_note=155017>1</sup>.
